Facet Carafe

A one-litre carafe with a cut lip that actually breaks the stream. Most carafes do not, and it is the only thing anyone notices.

$110

Finish

Free shipping over $250 · 30-day returns, postage paid · Nothing on this site can actually be purchased.

Detail

Pours without dribbling. This took four prototypes.

The lip profile went through four rounds before it stopped running down the side. The faceted body is not styling — it is what lets you grip a wet carafe with one hand.

Care. Hand wash. The cut lip will dull in a dishwasher.
